entities.summary: David William Sims is an American musician, best known as the bass guitarist of the bands Scratch Acid, Rapeman, and the Jesus Lizard. He has also recorded or performed with Sparklehorse, Rhys Chatham, Shivaree, Pigface, Flour, and others. Sims currently performs experimental solo electric bass as Unfact.
